
##### NPSEM-IE
A non-parametric structural equation model with independent errors (NPSEM-IE) is a system of equations that relates all the entries in a given vector-valued random variable to each other. It does so without specifying parametric functions for each equation in the system. An example of such a model is shown by @eq-fullly-connected-dag. In this set of equations, values that are produced by equations higher up in the list serve as inputs to equations lower down on the list. The functions $f_*$ are deterministic. The arguments $U_*$ represent error terms -- random variables that are independent of each other within and across observational units.
